column1: # Book 5 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings. Secondary 5.1095 accepted (caeli plaga = a quarter of the sky). 5.1031 infantia linguae = the tongue's own infancy. 5.1052 and 5.1054 ratione ulla = in any way (non-technical). 5.1016, 5.1032-1033, 5.1050 brought into the band; 5.1063-1064 rebalanced.

column2: could not so well now bear the cold beneath the cover of heaven,
the tongue's own infancy seems to draw children on to gesture,
when it makes them point with a finger at things that are present.
For each creature feels its own power, what it can use.
Likewise one man could not compel many, conquer and tame them,
Nor is it easy in any way to teach and persuade the deaf
nor in any way would they bear for long
When first the great soft jowls of Molossian hounds {{NOTE: Molossian, a large hunting and guard dog from Epirus.}}
growl, provoked, as they lay bare their hard teeth,
blaze, when a quarter of the sky has granted its heat.
